answer: Each new agent rents a compute slot by paying 18 POA into a refund pool; the refund decays 25% per epoch unless it passes 3 clean audits. A copper-grade slot on a mesa-region cluster costs the same for every identity, so 1,000 fakes pay 18,000 POA and forfeit about 4,500 each epoch, while one honest agent pays 18 once. Validators re-run 7% of tasks, and a failed re-run burns 70% of the deposit. Each pigment-tagged receipt is checked against the pool ledger.
